description: This file defines a custom JSP tag class 'PageContentTag' used to dynamically fetch and render content based on a content code, store, and language context in a web application.

classes.name: PageContentTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag class that retrieves and displays page content based on a code, with lazy autowiring of the ContentService.

methods.name: getContentCode
methods.description: Getter for the content code used to identify the content to display.

methods.name: doStartTagInternal
methods.description: Core method that initializes the service if needed, retrieves content based on code and context, and outputs it.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Method indicating the end of tag processing.
